description: Project-authored technical checks for the coupled SUMMA-mizuRoute executable. The fixture consists only of the two validation scripts, mounted read-only. Provenance checks verify recorded artefact hashes and embedded source identity; load checks verify ELF format, dynamic linkage, the SUMMA version command and that the mizuRoute coupling (-c/--config) is compiled in. These checks contain no scientific case and do not establish numerical or forecasting validity.
source: Floodcast tests/integration/hydrology/check_model.py and validate_outputs.py, identified by the validation profile hashes.
license: Not separately specified; Floodcast project-authored validation code, with no third-party fixture data included.
expectations: Recorded model artefact hashes and full source revisions (SUMMA and its mizuRoute/toml-f submodules) match the installed image
The coupled executable is a little-endian 64-bit ELF file and its dynamic libraries resolve
SUMMA supports its documented version command and reports -c/--config; libsumma contains the mizuRoute coupling
A zero exit status applies only to the explicitly selected technical check
tolerance_rationale: These are exact identity, format and linkage checks. There are no numerical quantities or scientific tolerances in this technical fixture.
